preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the number of words in the scroll.
Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty lowercase English letter string (word).
The total length of all words does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of valid ways to recover the original scroll modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < len(words[i]) for i, word in enumerate(words) for j in range(len(word)))
postconditions.description: For each word in the scroll, if a letter is deleted (i.e., a spell is undone), the deleted position is a valid index in the word.

postconditions.expression: all(words[i] == words[i-1] or (words[i] != words[i-1] and (len(words[i]) == len(words[i-1]) and words[i] > words[i-1] or len(words[i]) == len(words[i-1]) - 1 and words[i][:k] + words[i][k+1:] <= words[i-1] for k in range(len(words[i])))))
postconditions.description: For every pair of consecutive words in the modified scroll (after deleting one letter from some words), the sequence must be lexicographically non-decreasing. This means either the words are equal, or the next word is lexicographically greater than the previous one after at most one deletion.
The words are parsed exactly as given in the input, with the first line being n and the rest being the words in order.

postconditions.expression: count == 0 if any(not (words[i] == words[i-1] or (words[i] != words[i-1] and (len(words[i]) == len(words[i-1]) and words[i] > words[i-1] or len(words[i]) == len(words[i-1]) - 1 and any(words[i][:k] + words[i][k+1:] <= words[i-1] for k in range(len(words[i])))))) for i in range(1, n)) else count
postconditions.description: If no valid way exists to recover the original scroll (i.e., no sequence of deletions makes the words lexicographically non-decreasing), the output is 0. Otherwise, the output is the count of all valid ways modulo 10^9+7.
